coding_standards: No hardcoded secrets or raw passwords in code or logs.
Shared state reads/writes on data_store must use data_lock.
Every handler change must be verified via scripts/validate_handlers.py.
All callback_data patterns must be defined in bot/handlers/callback_constants.py.
All type ignores must be documented in scripts/check_type_ignore.py and pass pyright.
Functions must maintain a threshold budget under 30 lines where possible.
All user-facing explanatory comments must prefer standard Arabic.
Synchronous blocking API calls inside async handlers must use run_blocking().
